title: Deepfake Lens scan JSON — result contract v2
description: Project-owned (not vendored) schema of `deepfake-lens scan --format json` from schema_version 2 (phase 0, G5/G6/G12/G24). Conclusions are one of three verdicts; evidence is classified deterministic/statistical/lexical; coverage records every check that ran, was skipped, or failed. Legacy v1 fields stay for read-compat and are derived from the v2 fields.

excluded_items.description: POST /api/report signed bodies only (X2): posted rows the server could not re-analyze inside the read roots — not in items, not signed as results; path, marker and reason only (never the client's result).

tool_version.description: Signed reports only (G30): tool version, inside the MAC.

model_pins.description: Signed reports only (G30): runtime-profile pins, inside the MAC; pin null = unpinned.

signature_note.description: Inside the MAC; says 서명 없음 when unsigned.

signature_key_id.description: Outside the MAC; mismatch is reported as 키 ID 불일치.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over every field except signature and signature_key_id.

unrecorded_files.description: X1: files of the scanned folder without an analysis result, by reason (also in the HTML/PDF report bodies, the evidence statement and the legal report). subfolders counts folders; every other reason counts files (P5: subfolder_files = files inside those folders, archive_rejected = refused archive members, failed = rows that failed without a result).

archive_rejected_by_category.description: P5: refused archive members per Korean category (압축 폭탄·예산 초과, 경로 이탈, 링크·특수 파일, 중첩 깊이 초과, 기타).

lines.description: Korean headline followed by one line per non-zero reason.

subfolder_detail.description: P5: one entry per subfolder a flat scan did not enter: regular files below it (recursive, symlinks neither followed nor counted); complete=false when the count stopped at a walk limit.

container_rows.description: Archive container rows among the verdict rows (already in the verdict counts, R5/N5).

subfolders_skipped.description: Subfolders of the scan root a non-recursive scan did not enter (0 when recursive) — never omitted silently (N8).

files_over_cap.description: Files the walk found beyond the --max-files cap — never analyzed, no row (X1); 0 when not capped.

subfolder_files_skipped.description: P5: regular files inside the subfolders a non-recursive scan did not enter (recursive count, symlinks excluded).

summary.description: Verdict counts only (D16): the legacy band counts high/medium/low/unknown are not serialized.

path.description: Row path relative to the scan root; archive members as "archive::inner", nested archive members as the full chain "a.zip::b.zip::c.png" (Y9; never ".unpacked/") (N11: /api/report refuses a row that does not fit this item contract).

result.description: null for a row without analysis (skipped, unsupported, failed, duplicate); draft 2020-12 applies a sibling $ref, so null must be its own anyOf branch (N3).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the analyzed file bytes (G11/G30); null when not hashed.

probability.description: Set only from a calibrated statistical item.

raw_score.description: Uncalibrated model/heuristic output (0-100); never a probability.

reason.description: Required (non-empty) for skipped/failed; failed starts with the exception class name.
